name: authority-scope-inventory
objective: Freeze a Captain-only full-stack impact map, explicit exclusions and authoritative truth ownership before any implementation change.
truthOwner: Current task + governance/Product Truth; DSH owns operational Captain truth, WLT owns financial truth, Identity/Workforce own authentication/profile gates.

tasks.objective: Build the authoritative Captain impact graph
tasks.currentProblem: Relevant Captain behavior is distributed across runtime, DSH shared/frontend/backend/contracts/data, Workforce/Identity, WLT and cross-surface readers; the requested architecture.drawio is empty.
tasks.requiredChange: Use the pinned SHA and applicable Product Truth to classify every Captain-facing/control/readback path and every top-level control-panel section as related or explicitly unrelated.
tasks.targetState: One bounded graph exists from app-captain through shared adapters/contracts/backend/persistence to only the surfaces affected by Captain state.
tasks.action: Inspect and reconcile the listed paths; do not infer architecture from the empty drawio or derived plans.
mustNotChange: Do not modify runtime/product/governance while executing this diagnostic package.
Do not pull a surface or domain into execution without a Captain-specific dependency.
Do not treat plans/smsm-dsh-wlt-journeys or architecture.drawio as Product Truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Every mandatory surface and control-panel section has an evidence-backed disposition.
Every in-scope write/read path names its truth owner and downstream Captain-specific consumers.
No unresolved scope item is silently omitted.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data/evidence; never restore a parallel source of truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U001 implementation commit after authoritative-owner changes, affected consumer migration, cleanup and required checks pass.

tasks.currentProblem: The repository contains broad DSH/WLT capabilities that share infrastructure but are not part of Captain journeys.
tasks.requiredChange: Keep catalog, marketing, generic analytics/dashboard/login, field-only finance and client-address privacy outside execution unless a direct Captain dependency is proven.
tasks.targetState: Future implementation cannot expand from Captain into unrelated product areas by proximity or shared folder membership.
tasks.action: Use coverage exclusions and reopen triggers as hard implementation boundaries.
mustNotChange: Do not implement app-field changes merely because WLT commissions also serve field actors.
Do not modify client-address/privacy ownership for Captain navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: All exclusions include evidence, reason and reopen trigger.
app-field is assessed but out of scope absent a proven Captain-caused cross-effect.
